items.html: And we have already explained above that the thirteenth Mazal in the beard of Arich Anpin is the Yesod in the beard, and from it is drawn the Yesod of ZA, in the secret of "He acquires everything," as above. And likewise the Daat of ZA is the aspect of the Yesod of Ima, as above; therefore the beard of ZA is drawn from the upper Yesod, from which was the aspect of the Daat of ZA.
